name: hasDerivAt_iteratedDeriv_mgf
statement: t ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) (n : ℕ) : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv n (mgf X μ)) μ[fun ω ↦ X ω ^ (n + 1) * exp (t * X ω)] t

have_tree.name: h_mem
have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 t, y ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)

name: deriv_cgf
statement: v ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) : deriv (cgf X μ) v = μ[fun ω ↦ X ω * exp (v * X ω)] / mgf X μ v

have_tree.name: hv
have_tree.type: Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (v * X ω)) μ

name: deriv_cgf_zero
statement: 0 ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) : deriv (cgf X μ) 0 = μ[X] / μ.real Set.univ

have_tree.name: h_mem
have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 v, y ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)

name: iteratedDeriv_two_cgf_eq_integral
statement: v ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) : iteratedDeriv 2 (cgf X μ) v = μ[fun ω ↦ (X ω - deriv (cgf X μ) v) ^ 2 * exp (v * X ω)] / mgf X μ v

have_tree.name: h_int
have_tree.type: Integrable (fun ω ↦ 2 * X ω * deriv (cgf X μ) v * exp (v * X ω)) μ

name: exists_cgf_eq_iteratedDeriv_two_cgf_mul
statement: 0 < t) (hc : μ[X] = 0) (hs : Set.Icc 0 t ⊆ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) : ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t, cgf X μ t = (iteratedDeriv 2 (cgf X μ) u) * t ^ 2 / 2
